comments_text: Comment: MK58911 is not toxic in two mammalian cells (lung fibroblasts and glioblastoma cells) and in the G. mellonella model and demonstrates both in vitro and in vivo antifungal efficacy. Moreover, the peptide acted on the membrane of fungal cells and induced necrosis.
cytotoxicity_text: [Ref.31867293]MK58911 was not toxic in lung fibroblasts (MRC5) and glioblastoma cells (U87) at tested concentrations, and a high IC50 of >500 μg/mL was observed in both mammalian cells.
hemolytic_activity_text: No hemolysis information or data found in the reference(s) presented in this entry
reference_text: Front Cell Infect Microbiol. 2019 Dec 6;9:419. doi: 10.3389/fcimb.2019.00419. eCollection 2019.
